brand_notes: Harman-owned Revel; Concerta2 is entry line (M16 bookshelf, F35/F36 towers, C25, S16, B10). Design traits: waveguide tweeter with acoustic lens, ceramic-composite aluminium woofers, CPG port, curved cabinet, 6 Ω ratings with ~4 Ω dips (asr-revel-m16). Sold via dealers, no direct price on revelspeakers.com; M16 listed 'Current' there while Audio Advice shows sold out/Discontinued label (mfr-revel-m16). Bookshelf line on site: M16, M126Be, M105, M106.
takeaways: Klippel LW ±1.4 dB, f3 57 Hz, sens 85.0 dB, pref 5.1/7.3.
Impedance min ~4.1 Ω per ASR (below-iec for 6 Ω nominal) vs 5.05 Ω per S&V.
THD up to ~1.8% in bass and ~1.1% near crossover (level not stated); no max-SPL data.
Critics (Audioholics, What Hi-Fi, HiFiReport) positive; WHF cautions bright partnering.
Only ~3 owner reports found: anecdotal; no QC issues.
Availability uncertain: Audio Advice sold out/Discontinued label; Revel site lists current.
